recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. The Jira-requested correction is already present in active source, so further source edits would be redundant.
issue_request: FHIR-18037 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Conformance correction for STU3. It reported that examples for the CapabilityStatement $versions operation rendered the operation name as singular $version and requested $versions instead.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites GH#f457061d66. Git commit f457061d669e397f21311d4270e88e439b4ffadd changed source/capabilitystatement/$versions-request.txt and source/capabilitystatement/$versions-request2.txt from GET [base]/$version to GET [base]/$versions. The singular request examples were introduced when those files were added in commit 5225d4ce59e486afab2a3da6c935fccc42f0d145.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and operationdefinition-CapabilityStatement-versions.xml still references the $versions request and response example files. Later same-operation history changed output parameter details, but the current operation definition and request examples consistently use the plural $versions spelling. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-18037 found no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current request example files already render all request examples as GET [base]/$versions, and a source search found no remaining singular $version operation request spelling in the relevant CapabilityStatement/versioning material.
